title: neottia deltoidea
intro: Neottia deltoidea, commonly known as the Greenadders, is a species of orchid native to the mountainous regions of Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Neottia deltoidea include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antispasmodic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-oxidant effects. Additionally, research suggests that the plant's bioactive compounds may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of various diseases.
